description: The app's own page (ui/), the only content with the bridge. It names the main window and no remote URL: no server page is ever loaded, and HTML the viewer shows is a sealed frame on its own scheme, which no capability names; the python tool's runner is a frame on a scheme of its own too, kept from the bridge not by this capability but by the bridge being given to a window's main frame only (see src-tauri/src/python.rs). A picture, sound or video the viewer shows comes from a third scheme, which serves only what a webview decodes and never runs, each answer sandboxed (src-tauri/src/media.rs); it is no frame and has no bridge either. A PDF and a 3D model are drawn by the server's own viewers, compiled in and served on the sealed scheme like any sealed page (src-tauri/src/sealed.rs): PDF.js is never a script of the app's page. The window permissions are the title bar's: moving, resizing, minimising, maximising and closing (which hides).
